experiment: P5 H4 two-continuation target-stability audit v1
status: post-OOF diagnostic using already materialized labels only
scope: all 43437 complete H4 horizons and all 81 schedules
comparisons: positive-opportunity prevalence separately under center-future and late-future
best positive schedule agreement across futures
candidate reward sign agreement and Pearson correlation on candidates active in either future
robust opportunity retained from the single-future union and intersection

definitions.single_future_opportunity: maximum signed reward under that continuation is greater than zero
definitions.single_future_choice: lexicographic argmax when maximum is positive, otherwise all-center
definitions.robust_opportunity: maximum across schedules of the minimum of the two continuation rewards is positive
